method: broad factual-premise probes for trade and household economy

cases.circumstances: a buyer brings flax yarn rather than coin
cases.situation: Ask what kinds of exchange arrangements could make this a plausible purchase without asserting either party's terms.

cases.circumstances: he seeks grain after unloading household vessels
